b: The LWLies Truth & Movies podcast is back… and now it's in video form.

This is the soft launch of our brand new format, where the LWLies team will be discussing the big movies, talking to our favourite directors and stars, and dedicating episodes to festivals, the best in physical media, industry trends, breaking news stories, or anything else that we feel like discussing. This first episode is a work in progress as part of a beta phase, with final roll-out expected in early 2027.
In this episode, host Leila Latif is joined by Hannah Strong and David Jenkins and we're talking about the 2026 BFI London Film Festival.

Edited by Anna Stafford and Hendrik Faller
With thanks to Marina Ashioti, Wendy Klerck, Tiarna Slocombe, Moira Letby, James Wright, Vince Medeiros, Maverick Pettit-Taylor, Duncan Harrison and Steph Pomphrey.
